# technitium_settings_tsig (Resource)

Manages the TSIG keys that authenticate zone transfers, notifies and dynamic updates (the TSIG tab of the Settings page).

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "tsig_secret" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

resource "technitium_settings_tsig" "this" {
  tsig_keys = [{
    key_name       = "transfer"
    shared_secret  = var.tsig_secret
    algorithm_name = "hmac-sha256"
  }]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `tsig_keys` (Attributes Set) The TSIG keys. An empty set removes all keys. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tsig_keys))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The resource identifier.

<a id="nestedatt--tsig_keys"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tsig_keys`

Required:

- `algorithm_name` (String) The HMAC algorithm: `hmac-md5.sig-alg.reg.int`, `hmac-sha1`, `hmac-sha256`, `hmac-sha256-128`, `hmac-sha384`, `hmac-sha384-192`, `hmac-sha512` or `hmac-sha512-256`.
- `key_name` (String) The key name. The server stores it in lower case without a trailing dot.
- `shared_secret` (String, Sensitive) The base64 encoded shared secret.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import technitium_settings_tsig.this settings_tsig
```
